reddit.title: Introducing New Features in Provincia: When the Colony Talks Back
reddit.body: We're excited to share our latest update for Provincia! Now, your settlers will communicate their needs directly through thought badges, and you'll receive real-time alerts for any issues in your colony. No more guessing what’s wrong—just click and resolve! Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/when-the-colony-talks-back?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=when-the-colony-talks-back

posts: Big changes are coming to Provincia! Your settlers will now display their needs and issues through intuitive badges and alerts. No more hidden problems—stay informed and keep your colony thriving! Read more: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/when-the-colony-talks-back?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=when-the-colony-talks-back

Discover all the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/when-the-colony-talks-back?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=when-the-colony-talks-back

steam.title: Provincia Update: When the Colony Talks Back
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce a major update for Provincia! Your colony will now communicate its needs directly through thought badges on settlers, and you'll receive alerts for any issues that arise. This update aims to make managing your settlement more intuitive and engaging. Learn more about these exciting features here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/when-the-colony-talks-back?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=when-the-colony-talks-back
